atoms.sound: Bei der Bildbeschreibung schildert man systematisch was im Bild zu sehen ist und wo es sich befindet. Hierbei wählt man eine sinnvolle Reihenfolge, um auf alle wichtigen Details einzugehen: von links nach rechts, von oben nach unten oder vom Vordergrund in den Hintergrund.

hint.text: Bei der Bildbeschreibung geht es lediglich um die reine Beschreibung der dargestellten Szene. Verzichte daher auf jegliche Art von Wertung oder Interpretation.

atoms.a: On the left side of the picture, you can see a sheep, lying under a tree.
In the centre, a man is sitting in front of a vegetable patch, picking tomatoes and collecting them in a basket.
In the bottom right-hand corner, you can see a woman who is standing on a path and carrying a basket of eggs.
In the top right-hand corner, there is a flying bird.
In the background, you can see a red barn on a hill, and it is surrounded by trees.

instruction.text: Lies dir die Bildbeschreibung genau durch.

atoms.text: This photograph shows a scene at the beach. In the foreground, on the right side, there is a girl holding plastic bottles. She is wearing turquoise gloves and a black t-shirt. The girl is staring into the camera with a serious expression. In the background, on the left side of the girl, you can see two people on the beach. They are wearing black shirts, and one of them is holding a rubbish bag, most likely to collect waste off the shore. Behind them, one can see the ocean and the blue sky.

instruction.text: Welches Bild wurde beschrieben? Wähle aus.

atoms.text: This photo depicts a scene in an alley. In the foreground, on the right side, there is a girl holding a phone in her hands. She is wearing a white t-shirt, a blue jacket, and a yellow backpack. The girl is staring at her phone with a sad expression, probably reading a message. Behind the girl, on the left side, there are two other teenage girls. The one on the left is laughing while holding her phone in her hand. The girl next to her is wearing a white t-shirt and a pink jacket while she is smiling. Both of them are looking at the girl in the foreground.

instruction.text: Welches Bild wurde beschrieben? Wähle aus.
Sieh dir das Bild genau an und vervollständige die Bildbeschreibung, indem du die Lücken füllst.

The scene in the ((++bottom_left-hand_corner top_right-hand_corner)) might represent his dream of ((++travelling saving)) the world. In the ((++foreground background)), on the left, you can spot a red ((++train car)), and to the right, the Big Ben and a temple. In the ((++centre corner)), there is a boy skydiving with ((++mountains trees)) behind him.

The top left-hand corner might show the boy's struggle to choose a future ((++career flat)). On the ((++left right)), there are two doctors, probably during an operation, while ((++on_the_right above)), a firefighter with a ((++red black)) uniform stands out. In the ((++background middle)), there are five red question marks.

The scene in the ((++top_right-hand_corner bottom-right-hand_corner)) might portray his dream of starting a family someday. On the ((++left right)), a house with a red roof is standing with trees behind it. On the ((++right left)), you can see a loving family with two adults and a younger boy ((++between under)) them. The adult on the left ((++is_carrying carries)) a baby.
